questions.q: What cargo was the caravan carrying to market?
options: Cones of salt wrapped in matting
Poured from high in a long amber arc, three rounds, each sweeter than the last
Quickly and in silence, before the wind rose

questions.q: What did you see when you woke during the midday rest?
options: A small desert fox with huge ears, watching the camp from ten paces
A sandstorm building on the horizon
Two riders approaching from the south
A hawk circling the rock outcrop
